The architecture

One people objective in. Your entire HR function, moving.

Talk to Us

Diane sits at the center of your HR function: reading every signal across your workforce, activating the right agents, executing across every stage of the employee lifecycle, and closing every loop back to your people goals.

What does your function actually need?

The right question changes everything.

Most HR leaders are managing processes. Diane starts with why your people aren’t staying, growing, or performing.

Do you know which employees are six months away from leaving?

Diane reads engagement patterns, performance trajectories, manager relationships, compensation benchmarks, and role tenure signals across your workforce. It surfaces flight risk before it becomes a resignation.

Why does every critical role still take three months to close?

Diane maps every bottleneck in your hiring funnel where candidates drop off, where interviewers delay, where feedback loops stall and activates agents to fix each one. Sourcing, screening, scheduling, and communication run in parallel.

When a new hire’s first 90 days go badly, how early do you find out?

Diane monitors onboarding health continuously task completion, manager check-ins, early engagement signals, access provisioning gaps and surfaces issues in week two, not week twelve.

Do your employees feel like anyone is actually listening?

Diane deploys an always-available employee intelligence layer answering queries, collecting sentiment, routing escalations, and surfacing systemic issues from aggregated signals.

From objective to outcome

This is how your HR function transforms.

Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, BambooHR, Greenhouse, Lever, LinkedIn Talent, your LMS, your survey tools connect what you have. Nothing migrates. Your data stays in your environment.

Zero rip-and-replace — Diane is the intelligence layer that makes your existing systems finally work together for your people.

Not a process checklist. A goal. “Reduce attrition in engineering by 20% this year.” “Cut time-to-hire for senior roles to 45 days.” Diane returns a ranked execution plan by role, by team, by action with reasoning attached.

People-first, always. Every action on the plan earns its place.

From 400+ agents, Diane calls what’s relevant to your workforce stage: recruiting, screening, onboarding, performance, L&D, retention, compliance. Build new agents at will or bring existing ones from any framework.

400+ agents · Activated by objective.

Roles get filled. People get onboarded. Diane tracks every outcome against your people objective. It doesn’t report on HR activity. It reports on people outcomes.

Every output loops back. The OS gets smarter with every employee cycle.

Bring your processes

Diane maps to how you manage people. Not the other way around.

Tell Diane how your HR function runs today. It enhances every stage of the employee lifecycle with agents built for that exact job.

Workforce planning

Headcount goals turned into ranked hiring prioritisation from live attrition, skills gap, and growth signals.

Talent sourcing

ICP-matched candidates identified from live talent pools, LinkedIn signals, and referral networks, continuously.

Screening & assessment

CV screening, initial assessments, and candidate scoring handled before a recruiter touches the file.

Interview coordination

Scheduling, reminders, panel coordination, and feedback collection automated end to end.

Onboarding

Personalised 30/60/90-day journeys, access provisioning and early check-ins, monitored for health.

Engagement & ESAT

Pulse surveys designed, deployed, and analysed automatically, before issues become exit interviews.

Performance management

Review cycles structured, managed, and analysed across teams, managers, and tenure cohorts.

L&D & skills development

Skills gap analysis mapped to personalised learning paths aligned to role and business priorities.

Attrition risk

Flight risk scoring per employee from engagement, tenure, compensation, and manager quality data.

HR help desk

Policy queries, leave requests, payroll questions resolved instantly and escalated intelligently.

Compliance & audit

Regulatory requirements tracked and audit trails maintained across every jurisdiction.

Offboarding & exit intelligence

Exit interviews analysed, access revoked, knowledge transferred and fed back to retention strategy.

The question you’re already asking

Your data. Your agents. Your call. Always.

Sovereign, governed and model-agnostic by design, so every agent and every workflow stays yours.

  • Stays in your environment

    Diane deploys in your cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, or on-premise. No data leaves. No training on your proprietary information. 80% of enterprise deployments choose private cloud.

  • Governed at every step

    Every agent action is logged. Every output validated. Human-in-the-loop controls for every decision that matters. SOC 2 Type II. GDPR-ready. EU AI Act compliant path.

  • No lock-in. Ever.

    What you build on Diane belongs to you. Walk away with every agent, every workflow, every intelligence layer fully intact. We are the infrastructure, not the owner of what you create on it.

  • Any model. Any framework.

    OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-source. LangChain, CrewAI, Agentforce. Diane runs them all under one control plane. You’re never dependent on one provider’s roadmap.
